$comment: Deliberate coverage exclusions for `bun run e2e --strict`. Every entry needs a reason a reviewer can check. A stale entry (the item is covered anyway) or a dead entry (the server no longer exposes it) fails the strict run. `flows` pins scenario names that must exist and pass.
